description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the EmailQueueService component within the OrangeHRM core plugin. It includes test cases for methods like adding emails to queue, sending emails, changing email status, and processing pending emails.

classes.name: EmailQueueServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of EmailQueueService in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmailQueueService instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmailQueueDao
methods.description: Tests that getEmailQueueDao() returns an instance of EmailQueueDao.

methods.name: testGetEmailService
methods.description: Verifies that getEmailService() is called correctly within the service.

methods.name: testAddToQueue
methods.description: Tests adding an email to the queue and checks that the Mail object is constructed correctly.

methods.name: testSendSingleMail
methods.description: Tests the process of sending a single email through mocked EmailService methods.

methods.name: testResetEmailService
methods.description: Verifies that resetEmailService resets or initializes the email service as expected.

methods.name: testChangeMailStatus
methods.description: Tests changing the status of a Mail object to 'started' and 'sent' and checks if sentAt is set.

methods.name: testSendAllPendingMails
methods.description: Tests processing all pending mails by mocking DAO and verifying loops over mail IDs.
